title: Murakkab qo‘shma gaplar tuzish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida teng va tobe bog‘lanish, sifatdosh gaplar hamda although va despite tuzilmalaridan foydalanib, o‘nta oddiy gapni to‘rtta xilma-xil murakkab gapga birlashtira olasiz.

scenes.title: Murakkab gaplar dunyosiga xush kelibsiz
board: Lesson: Building complex sentences
(Murakkab qo‘shma gaplar tuzish)
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we looked at formal and informal letters. Today we move from short, simple sentences to rich, flexible ones that sound like a confident writer.
scenes.say_native: Xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan darsda oldingi darsimizda rasmiy va norasmiy xatlarni ko‘rib chiqdik. Bugun oddiy qisqa gaplardan boy va ravon gaplarga o‘tamiz. Oldingi darsda xat yozishni o‘rgangan edik, endi yozuvingiz ishonchli yozuvchinikiga o‘xshab eshitiladigan bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan darsda rasmiy va norasmiy xatlarni ko‘rdik. Bugun qisqa oddiy gaplardan ishonchli yozuvchiga xos boy va ravon gaplarga o‘tamiz.

scenes.title: Teng bog‘lanish: coordination
board: Coordination = teng gaplar
for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so
I was tired, but I finished the report.

examples.t: I was tired, but I finished the report.
She could stay, or she could leave.
examples.uz: U qolishi ham, ketishi ham mumkin edi.

scenes.say: Coordination joins two equal parts. We use for, and, nor, but, or, yet and so. Each part could stand alone as a sentence.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: teng bog‘lanish. Teng bog‘lovchilar ikkita mustaqil gapni bir xil darajada bog‘laydi. Ingliz tilida ularni “FANBOYS” deb eslab qolishadi: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so. Har bir bo‘lak o‘zi yakka gap bo‘la oladi. Ikki to‘liq gap orasida bog‘lovchidan oldin odatda vergul qo‘yiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Teng bog‘lanish ikki teng qismni birlashtiradi. Biz for, and, nor, but, or, yet va so dan foydalanamiz. Har bir qism alohida gap bo‘la oladi.

scenes.title: Yet, so va for ning ma’nosi
board: yet = but (kutilmagan zid)
so = natija (result)
for = sabab (formal, because)

examples.t: The plan was simple, yet it failed.
examples.uz: Reja oddiy edi, biroq barbod bo‘ldi.

examples.t: He was late, so we started without him.
examples.uz: U kechikdi, shuning uchun biz usiz boshladik.

examples.t: We stayed in, for it was raining.
examples.uz: Uyda qoldik, chunki yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi.

scenes.say: Yet shows a surprising contrast. So gives a result. For gives a reason, but it is formal and mostly written.
scenes.say_native: Uchta bog‘lovchiga alohida e’tibor bering. “Yet” — “but” ga yaqin, lekin kutilmagan ziddiyatni bildiradi. “So” — natija: oldin sabab, keyin oqibat keladi. “For” esa “because” ma’nosida, lekin u rasmiy va asosan yozma nutqda uchraydi, hamda faqat gapning o‘rtasida turadi. Gapni “For it was raining”
scenes.say_uz: Yet kutilmagan ziddiyatni bildiradi. So natijani beradi. For sababni bildiradi, lekin rasmiy va asosan yozma.

scenes.title: Tobe bog‘lanish: subordination
board: Subordination = bosh gap + ergash gap
because, when, if, although, while, since
Main clause + subordinate clause

examples.t: Because the train was late, we missed the meeting.
examples.uz: Poyezd kechikkani uchun yig‘ilishni o‘tkazib yubordik.

examples.t: I'll call you when I arrive.

scenes.say: Subordination joins a main clause to a subordinate clause. The subordinate clause cannot stand alone. It begins with a word like because, when, if or although.
scenes.say_native: Endi tobe bog‘lanish. Bu yerda bitta gap bosh, ikkinchisi unga tobe, ya’ni ergash gap bo‘ladi. Ergash gap yolg‘iz o‘zi to‘liq fikr bildirmaydi: “Because the train was late” deganda tinglovchi “xo‘sh, nima bo‘ldi?” deb kutib qoladi. Ergash gap because, when, if, although, while, since kabi bog‘lovchi so‘zdan boshlanadi.
scenes.say_uz: Tobe bog‘lanish bosh gapni ergash gap bilan bog‘laydi. Ergash gap yakka tura olmaydi. U because, when, if yoki although kabi so‘zdan boshlanadi.

scenes.title: Ergash gap turlari
board: Time: when, after, before, until
Reason: because, since, as
Condition: if, unless, provided that
Contrast: although, whereas, while

examples.t: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
Since you're here, let's start.

scenes.say: Subordinators come in groups: time, reason, condition and contrast. Choose the one that matches the relationship between your ideas.
scenes.say_native: Tobe bog‘lovchilar ma’no guruhlariga bo‘linadi. Vaqt uchun when, after, before, until. Sabab uchun because, since, as. Shart uchun if, unless, provided that. Zidlik uchun although, whereas, while. Muhim qoida: avval ikki fikr orasidagi munosabatni aniqlang, keyin mos so‘zni tanlang. “Unless” degani “agar ...
scenes.say_uz: Bog‘lovchilar guruhlarga bo‘linadi: vaqt, sabab, shart va zidlik. Fikrlaringiz orasidagi munosabatga mos so‘zni tanlang.

scenes.title: Nisbiy gaplar: who, which, that, whose
board: who — odam
which — narsa
that — odam / narsa (norasmiyroq)
whose — egalik

examples.t: The manager who hired me is leaving.
The report, which I wrote last week, is ready.
She is a writer whose books are famous.

scenes.say: Relative clauses are subordinate clauses that add information about a noun. Use who for people, which for things, that for both, and whose for possession.
scenes.say_native: Ergash gapning eng foydali turi — nisbiy gap. U otga qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi. Odamlar uchun “who”, narsalar uchun “which”, ikkalasi uchun “that”, egalik uchun “whose” ishlatiladi. Farqni biling: “The report, which I wrote last week, is ready” — qo‘shimcha ma’lumot, u vergullar orasida turadi va bu yerda “that”
scenes.say_uz: Nisbiy gaplar otga ma’lumot qo‘shadi. Odamlar uchun who, narsalar uchun which, ikkalasi uchun that, egalik uchun whose.

scenes.title: Ingliz va o‘zbek gap qurilishi
board: Uzbek: ergash gap + -ib/-gach bosh gap
English: conjunction + clause
The conjunction comes FIRST

examples.t: When I got home, I cooked dinner.

scenes.say: English puts the conjunction at the start of the clause. Uzbek often places the verb ending at the end. The order of ideas is similar, but the grammar is different.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek bilan solishtiramiz. O‘zbek tilida ergash gap ko‘pincha fe’lning oxiriga qo‘shiladigan qo‘shimcha bilan yasaladi: “kelgach”, “o‘qiganim uchun”. Inglizchada esa bog‘lovchi so‘z ergash gapning boshida turadi: When I got home. Shuning uchun inglizcha gapni tuzayotganda avval bog‘lovchini qo‘ying, keyin to‘liq gap, ya’ni ega va fe’lni yozing.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tili bog‘lovchini ergash gap boshiga qo‘yadi. O‘zbekcha fe’l oxiridagi qo‘shimcha bilan yasaydi. Fikrlar tartibi o‘xshash, grammatika esa boshqacha.

scenes.title: Vergul bilan bog‘lab yuborish xatosi
board: ✗ I was tired, I went to bed.
✓ I was tired, so I went to bed.
✓ I was tired; I went to bed.
✓ Because I was tired, I went to bed.
scenes.say: A comma alone cannot join two full sentences. This mistake is called a comma splice. Add a conjunction, use a semicolon, or make one clause subordinate.
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — “comma splice”, ya’ni ikki to‘liq gapni faqat vergul bilan bog‘lash. O‘zbek tilida bunday yozish ko‘p uchraydi, shuning uchun siz bu odatni inglizchaga ko‘chirishingiz mumkin. Ingliz tilida vergul bog‘lovchi o‘rnini bosa olmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Vergul yolg‘iz ikki to‘liq gapni bog‘lay olmaydi. Bu xato comma splice deyiladi. Bog‘lovchi qo‘shing, nuqtali vergul ishlating yoki bitta gapni ergash gap qiling.

scenes.title: Bog‘lang va tuzating
board: 1) He studied hard, he failed. (yet)
2) We were hungry. We ordered food. (so)
3) It was cold. We went swimming. (although)
scenes.say: Join each pair. One: He studied hard, he failed, with yet. Two: We were hungry, we ordered food, with so. Three: It was cold, we went swimming, with although.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta juftlikni berilgan so‘z bilan bog‘lang. Birinchisi: u qattiq o‘qidi, lekin yiqildi — “yet” bilan. Ikkinchisi: biz och edik, ovqat buyurdik — “so” bilan. Uchinchisi: sovuq edi, biz suzishga bordik — “although” bilan. Vergul qayerga kerakligini ham o‘ylang. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir juftlikni birlashtiring. Bir: yet bilan. Ikki: so bilan. Uch: although bilan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) He studied hard, yet he failed.
2) We were hungry, so we ordered food.
3) Although it was cold, we went swimming.
scenes.say: One: He studied hard, yet he failed. Two: We were hungry, so we ordered food. Three: Although it was cold, we went swimming.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “He studied hard, yet he failed” — “yet” dan oldin vergul. Ikkinchi: “We were hungry, so we ordered food” — “so” dan oldin ham vergul. Uchinchi: “Although it was cold, we went swimming” — ergash gap avval kelganda vergul ergash gapdan keyin turadi. E’tibor bering, uchinchisida “but”
scenes.say_uz: Bir: He studied hard, yet he failed. Ikki: We were hungry, so we ordered food. Uch: Although it was cold, we went swimming.

scenes.title: Ergash gap o‘rni va vergul
board: If you call, I'll come. (vergul bor)
I'll come if you call. (vergul yo‘q)
Rule: subordinate clause first → comma

examples.t: When the film ended, everyone clapped.
Everyone clapped when the film ended.

scenes.say: A subordinate clause can come first or second. If it comes first, put a comma after it. If it comes second, you usually need no comma.
scenes.say_native: Ergash gap bosh gapdan oldin ham, keyin ham kelishi mumkin. Agar u gap boshida kelsa, uning oxirida vergul qo‘yasiz. Agar bosh gapdan keyin kelsa, odatda vergul kerak bo‘lmaydi. Ikkalasining ma’nosi bir xil, lekin ta’kid farq qiladi: gap boshidagi gap ko‘proq fon yoki sharoitni beradi, oxiridagisi esa yangi ma’lumotni qo‘shadi.
scenes.say_uz: Ergash gap oldin yoki keyin kelishi mumkin. Oldin kelsa, vergul qo‘ying. Keyin kelsa, odatda vergul kerak emas.

scenes.title: Ikkita bog‘lovchi ishlatmang
board: ✗ Although it rained, but we went out.
✓ Although it rained, we went out.
✗ Because he was ill, so he stayed home.
✓ Because he was ill, he stayed home.
scenes.say: Use only one connector for one relationship. Although already shows contrast, so you do not need but. Because already shows reason, so you do not need so.
scenes.say_native: Bu xato o‘zbek tilidan keladi. Biz “garchi yomg‘ir yog‘gan bo‘lsa-da, lekin chiqdik” deymiz va ikkita bog‘lovchi bir gapda turadi. Inglizchada bunday qilib bo‘lmaydi. Bitta munosabat uchun bitta bog‘lovchi yetadi. “Although” zidlikni o‘zi beradi, shuning uchun “but” ortiqcha. “Because” sababni o‘zi beradi, “so”
scenes.say_uz: Bir munosabat uchun bitta bog‘lovchi ishlating. Although zidlikni o‘zi bildiradi, shuning uchun but kerak emas. Because bo‘lsa, so kerak emas.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 1) Because I was late, so I ran.
2) She is tired, she keeps working.
3) When I will arrive, I'll call you.
scenes.say: Find the mistake in each sentence and correct it. One: Because I was late, so I ran. Two: She is tired, she keeps working. Three: When I will arrive, I'll call you.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda xato bor. Birinchisi: “Because I was late, so I ran”. Ikkinchisi: “She is tired, she keeps working”. Uchinchisi: “When I will arrive, I’ll call you”. Uchinchisida oldingi darslardagi vaqt ergash gapi qoidasini eslang. Har birini to‘g‘rilab, baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapdagi xatoni toping va to‘g‘rilang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Because I was late, I ran.
2) She is tired, but she keeps working.
3) When I arrive, I'll call you.
scenes.say: One: Because I was late, I ran. Two: She is tired, but she keeps working. Three: When I arrive, I'll call you.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ortiqcha “so” ni olib tashlaymiz — “Because I was late, I ran”. Ikkinchi: bu comma splice edi, “but” qo‘shamiz yoki “Although she is tired, she keeps working” deymiz. Uchinchi: vaqt ergash gapida kelasi zamon ishlatilmaydi, hozirgi zamon turadi: “When I arrive”.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Because I was late, I ran. Ikki: She is tired, but she keeps working. Uch: When I arrive, I'll call you.

scenes.title: Hozirgi sifatdosh gaplari: -ing
board: V-ing clause = faol, bir vaqtda yoki sabab
Walking home, I met Tom.
= While I was walking home, I met Tom.

examples.t: Walking home, I met an old friend.
examples.uz: Uyga piyoda ketayotib, eski do‘stimni uchratdim.

examples.t: Feeling tired, she went to bed early.
examples.uz: Charchaganini sezib, u erta uxlashga yotdi.

scenes.say: A participle clause with -ing replaces a longer subordinate clause. The subject of the participle must be the same as the subject of the main clause.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: sifatdosh gaplar. Ular gapni qisqartiradi va yozuvni professional qiladi. Fe’lga -ing qo‘shib, ega va bog‘lovchini tashlab yuboramiz. “While I was walking home, I met a friend” o‘rniga “Walking home, I met a friend” deymiz. O‘zbek tilidagi “-ib” va “-gach”
scenes.say_uz: -ing li sifatdosh gap uzunroq ergash gapni almashtiradi. Sifatdoshning egasi bosh gapning egasi bilan bir xil bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: O‘tgan zamon sifatdoshi: V3
board: V3 clause = majhul (passive) ma’no
Built in 1900, the bridge is still strong.
= Because it was built in 1900, ...

examples.t: Built in 1900, the bridge is still strong.
examples.uz: 1900 yilda qurilgan ko‘prik hali ham mustahkam.

examples.t: Surprised by the news, he sat down.
examples.uz: Xabardan hayratga tushib, u o‘tirib qoldi.

scenes.say: A past participle clause has a passive meaning. The thing described receives the action. The subject of the main clause must be the one that was built, surprised or affected.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi shakl, ya’ni V3 bilan boshlangan sifatdosh gap majhul ma’noga ega. “Built in 1900” degani “1900 yilda qurilgan”, ya’ni ko‘prik qurilgan, uni kimdir qurgan. “Surprised by the news” — “xabardan hayratga tushgan”. Bu yerda ham qoida o‘sha: bosh gapning egasi shu holatni boshidan kechirayotgan narsa yoki odam bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say_uz: V3 bilan boshlangan sifatdosh gap majhul ma’noga ega. Bosh gapning egasi shu ish ta’sir qilgan narsa bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: Tugallangan ish: Having + V3
board: Having + V3 = oldin tugagan ish
Having finished, she left.
= After she had finished, she left.

examples.t: Having finished the report, she went home.
Having been warned, they took a taxi.

scenes.say: Having plus past participle shows that one action finished before another. It is useful for sequences and for reasons.
scenes.say_native: Agar birinchi ish ikkinchisidan oldin batamom tugagan bo‘lsa, “Having” va uchinchi shakl ishlatiladi. “Having finished the report, she went home” — hisobotni tugatgach, u uyga ketdi. Bu “After she had finished” ning qisqa shakli. Majhul shakli “Having been warned” — ogohlantirilgach.
scenes.say_uz: Having va V3 bir ish boshqasidan oldin tugaganini ko‘rsatadi. Bu ketma-ketlik va sabab uchun foydali.

scenes.title: Dangling participle
board: ✗ Walking home, the rain started.
✓ Walking home, I got caught in the rain.
✗ Having read the book, the film was boring.
✓ Having read the book, I found the film boring.
scenes.say: A dangling participle has no logical subject. The doer of the participle must be the subject of the main clause.
scenes.say_native: Eng mashhur xato — “dangling participle”, ya’ni “osilib qolgan” sifatdosh. “Walking home, the rain started” deganda go‘yo yomg‘irning o‘zi uyga yurib ketayotgandek eshitiladi. Chunki sifatdoshning egasi bosh gapning egasi bilan mos kelmayapti. Yechim oddiy: sifatdosh gapdan keyingi birinchi ot ish bajaruvchi bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Osilib qolgan sifatdoshning mantiqiy egasi yo‘q. Sifatdoshni bajaruvchi bosh gapning egasi bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: Gapni qisqartiring
board: 1) While she was waiting, she read. → ?
2) Because he was exhausted, he slept. → ?
3) After they had eaten, they left. → ?
scenes.say: Shorten each sentence with a participle clause. One: While she was waiting, she read. Two: Because he was exhausted, he slept. Three: After they had eaten, they left.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni sifatdosh gap bilan qisqartiring. Birinchisi: “While she was waiting, she read”. Ikkinchisi: “Because he was exhausted, he slept”. Uchinchisi: “After they had eaten, they left”. Maslahat: birinchisida -ing, ikkinchisida holat sifatdoshi, uchinchisida “Having” kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni sifatdosh gap bilan qisqartiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Waiting, she read.
2) Exhausted, he slept.
3) Having eaten, they left.
scenes.say: One: Waiting, she read. Two: Exhausted, he slept. Three: Having eaten, they left.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Waiting, she read” — ega va “was” tushib qoladi. Ikkinchi: “Exhausted, he slept” — “being” ni ham tashlasa bo‘ladi, shunda gap chiroyliroq chiqadi. Uchinchi: “Having eaten, they left”. Uchala gapda ham ish bajaruvchi bosh gapning egasi bilan bir xil.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Waiting, she read. Ikki: Exhausted, he slept. Uch: Having eaten, they left.

scenes.title: Qisqartirilgan nisbiy gaplar
board: who is/was ... → V-ing / V3
The man standing there is my boss.
The report written by Ann is excellent.

examples.t: The woman standing by the door is my boss.
examples.uz: Eshik yonida turgan ayol mening boshliqim.

examples.t: The report written by Ann is excellent.

scenes.say: We can shorten a relative clause by removing who or which plus the verb be. Use -ing for active meaning and V3 for passive meaning.
scenes.say_native: Sifatdosh gaplar nisbiy gapni ham qisqartiradi. “The woman who is standing by the door” o‘rniga “The woman standing by the door” deymiz, ya’ni who va be fe’lini olib tashlaymiz. Faol ma’noda -ing, majhulda uchinchi shakl ishlatamiz: “The report which was written by Ann” bo‘ladi “The report written by Ann”.
scenes.say_uz: Who yoki which va be ni olib tashlab, nisbiy gapni qisqartirish mumkin. Faol ma’noda -ing, majhulda V3 ishlating.

scenes.title: Qisqartirilgan gapni tuzing
board: 1) The students who are studying here are foreign.
2) The house which was built in 1950 is cheap.
3) The people who live next door are noisy.
scenes.say: Shorten each relative clause. One: The students who are studying here are foreign. Two: The house which was built in 1950 is cheap. Three: The people who live next door are noisy. Careful with number three.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapdagi nisbiy gapni qisqartiring. Uchinchisiga ehtiyot bo‘ling: u “be” fe’lisiz, oddiy hozirgi zamon. Savol: bunda nima qilish mumkin? Barcha uchala javobni baland ovozda ayting, keyin tekshirib ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir nisbiy gapni qisqartiring. Uchinchisiga ehtiyot bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The students studying here are foreign.
2) The house built in 1950 is cheap.
3) The people living next door are noisy.
scenes.say: One: The students studying here are foreign. Two: The house built in 1950 is cheap. Three: The people living next door are noisy.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “The students studying here”. Ikkinchi: “The house built in 1950” — majhul, shuning uchun uchinchi shakl. Uchinchi: “The people living next door”. Ko‘rdingiz, oddiy zamonda ham who va fe’lni -ing shakliga almashtirsa bo‘ladi, agar bu doimiy yoki hozirgi holat bo‘lsa. Bu holat “be”
scenes.say_uz: Bir: The students studying here. Ikki: The house built in 1950. Uch: The people living next door.

scenes.title: Although, though va even though
board: Although + clause
Though — norasmiy, oxirida ham mumkin
Even though — kuchliroq ta’kid

examples.t: Although it was late, we kept working.
It's a good flat. It's expensive, though.
Even though he is rich, he is unhappy.

scenes.say: Although, though and even though introduce a contrast with an unexpected result. Even though is stronger. Though can also come at the end of a sentence in informal speech.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: zidlik, ya’ni concession. Birinchi guruh: although, though, even though. Hammasi “garchi ... bo‘lsa-da” degan ma’noni beradi. “Even though” eng kuchli, chunki u haqiqiy faktni ta’kidlaydi. “Though” esa norasmiyroq, va u gap oxirida ham kelishi mumkin: “It’s expensive, though” — “lekin qimmat”.
scenes.say_uz: Although, though va even though kutilmagan natijali zidlikni bildiradi. Even though kuchliroq. Though norasmiy nutqda gap oxirida ham keladi.

scenes.title: Despite va in spite of
board: Despite + noun / V-ing
In spite of + noun / V-ing
Despite the fact that + clause

examples.t: Despite the rain, we went out.
In spite of feeling ill, he came to work.
examples.uz: O‘zini yomon sezishiga qaramay, u ishga keldi.

examples.t: Despite the fact that it was late, we stayed.

scenes.say: Despite and in spite of have the same meaning, but they are followed by a noun or an -ing form, not a full clause. To use a clause, add the fact that.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh: despite va in spite of. Ma’nosi bir xil — “...ga qaramay”. Lekin grammatik farq muhim: ulardan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi, to‘liq gap emas. “Despite the rain”, “despite feeling ill”. Agar sizda to‘liq gap bo‘lsa, “the fact that” qo‘shasiz: “Despite the fact that it was late”.
scenes.say_uz: Despite va in spite of dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi. To‘liq gap uchun the fact that qo‘shamiz.

scenes.title: While, whereas va ravishlar
board: whereas / while = ikki narsani qarama-qarshi qo‘yish
however, nevertheless = gaplararo
; however, ...

examples.t: Tom is outgoing, whereas his brother is shy.
examples.uz: Tom ochiq, uning akasi esa uyatchan.

examples.t: The plan was risky. Nevertheless, they went ahead.
examples.uz: Reja xavfli edi. Shunga qaramay, ular davom ettirishdi.

scenes.say: Whereas and while compare two different things. However and nevertheless link separate sentences. After them we usually put a comma.
scenes.say_native: Zidlikni ifodalashning yana ikki yo‘li bor. “Whereas” va “while” ikki narsani qiyoslaydi: Tom ochiq, akasi esa uyatchan. Ikkinchi yo‘l — gaplararo so‘zlar: “however” va “nevertheless”. Ular ergash gap emas, shuning uchun oldidan nuqta yoki nuqtali vergul qo‘yiladi, keyin vergul: “It was risky; nevertheless, they went ahead.”
scenes.say_uz: Whereas va while ikki narsani qiyoslaydi. However va nevertheless alohida gaplarni bog‘laydi va ulardan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi.

scenes.title: Despite xatolari
board: ✗ Despite of the rain, we went.
✗ Despite it was raining, we went.
✓ Despite the rain, we went.
✓ Despite the fact that it was raining, we went.
scenes.say: Do not say despite of. Do not put a full clause after despite. Use a noun, an -ing form, or the fact that.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “despite of”, ya’ni ortiqcha “of”. Inglizcha “in spite of” da “of” bor, “despite” da yo‘q. Ikkinchisi: “despite” dan keyin to‘liq gap qo‘yish. Uchinchisi: “although” dan keyin ot qo‘yish, masalan “although the rain”. Qoidani yodlab oling: although bilan gap, despite bilan ot.
scenes.say_uz: Despite of demang. Despite dan keyin to‘liq gap qo‘ymang. Ot, -ing yoki the fact that ishlating.

scenes.title: Although dan despite ga
board: 1) Although it was cold, we went out. → Despite ...
2) Despite being tired, she smiled. → Although ...
3) She passed, despite not studying. → ... the fact that ...
scenes.say: Rewrite each sentence. One: Although it was cold, we went out, using despite. Two: Despite being tired, she smiled, using although. Three: She passed despite not studying, using the fact that.
scenes.say_native: Mashq: gaplarni qayta yozing. Birinchi: “Although it was cold, we went out” — “despite” bilan. Ikkinchi: “Despite being tired, she smiled” — “although” bilan. Uchinchi: “She passed despite not studying” — “despite the fact that” bilan. Har birida fe’l shakli ham o‘zgaradi, shuning uchun sekin o‘ylang.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni qayta yozing. Bir: despite bilan. Ikki: although bilan. Uch: the fact that bilan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Despite the cold, we went out.
2) Although she was tired, she smiled.
3) She passed despite the fact that she didn't study.
scenes.say: One: Despite the cold, we went out. Two: Although she was tired, she smiled. Three: She passed despite the fact that she didn't study.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Despite the cold, we went out” — “it was cold” ot shakliga o‘tdi: “the cold”. Ikkinchi: “Although she was tired, she smiled” — -ing shakli to‘liq gapga aylandi. Uchinchi: “despite the fact that she didn’t study”. Ko‘rdingizmi, ma’no o‘zgarmadi, faqat tuzilma o‘zgardi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Despite the cold, we went out. Ikki: Although she was tired, she smiled. Uch: She passed despite the fact that she didn't study.

scenes.title: Tinglash: hisobotni tahrirlash
board: Anna: Although the data is strong, the report feels flat.
Ben: Having read it twice, I agree.
Anna: Short sentences, all the same length.
Ben: Let's join some, and start others differently.
scenes.say: Anna: Although the data is strong, the report feels flat. Ben: Having read it twice, I agree. Every sentence is short, and they all begin with the subject. Anna: So let's join a few, and start others differently. Ben: Good idea. Despite the deadline, we have time to do this properly.
scenes.say_native: Endi dialog. Ikki hamkasb hisobotni tahrirlayapti. Anna ma’lumotlar kuchli, lekin matn bir xil va zerikarli ekanini aytadi. Ben ikki marta o‘qib chiqqanini, hamma gap qisqa va ega bilan boshlanishini ta’kidlaydi. Ular ba’zi gaplarni birlashtirishga va boshqalarini boshqacha boshlashga qaror qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Ma’lumotlar kuchli bo‘lsa-da, hisobot bir xil tuyulyapti. Ben: Ikki marta o‘qib chiqib, men rozi bo‘laman. Hamma gap qisqa va ega bilan boshlanadi. Anna: Keling, bir nechtasini birlashtiramiz va boshqalarini boshqacha boshlaymiz. Ben: Yaxshi fikr. Muddatga qaramay, buni yaxshilab qilishga vaqtimiz bor.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What is wrong with the report?
2) What does Ben notice about the sentences?
3) What do they decide to do?
scenes.say: Three questions. One: what is wrong with the report? Two: what does Ben notice about the sentences? Three: what do they decide to do?
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: hisobotda nima muammo? Ikkinchi: Ben gaplar haqida nimani payqaydi? Uchinchi: ular nima qilishga qaror qiladi? To‘liq inglizcha gap bilan javob bering va imkon bo‘lsa, murakkab tuzilma ishlating, masalan “Although ...”.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Hisobotda nima muammo? Ben gaplar haqida nimani payqaydi? Ular nima qilishga qaror qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Strong data, but flat style.
2) All sentences are short, same pattern.
3) Join some, vary the openings.
scenes.say: One: the data is strong, but the style feels flat. Two: all the sentences are short and begin with the subject. Three: they join some sentences and start others in different ways.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ma’lumotlar kuchli, lekin uslub yassi, ya’ni jonsiz. Ikkinchi: barcha gaplar qisqa va bir xil tuzilishda, ega bilan boshlanadi. Uchinchi: ular ba’zi gaplarni birlashtiradi va boshqalarini turli yo‘llar bilan boshlaydi. Aynan shu to‘rtinchi nuqtaning, ya’ni gaplarni xilma-xil qilishning mohiyati.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ma’lumotlar kuchli, uslub yassi. Ikki: hamma gap qisqa va ega bilan boshlanadi. Uch: ba’zilarini birlashtiradi, boshlanishini o‘zgartiradi.

scenes.title: To‘rt turdagi gap
board: Simple: I left.
Compound: I left, and she stayed.
Complex: When I left, she stayed.
Compound-complex: When I left, she stayed, and he cried.
scenes.say: There are four sentence types. Simple has one clause. Compound has two equal clauses. Complex has a main and a subordinate clause. Compound-complex combines both.
scenes.say_native: Gaplarning to‘rt turi bor. Sodda gap bitta mustaqil gapdan iborat. Qo‘shma teng gap ikkita teng gapdan tuzilgan. Murakkab, ya’ni tobe bog‘lanishli gapda bosh va ergash gap bor. Aralash turda esa ikkalasi birga keladi. Yaxshi matn bularning hammasini aralashtiradi.
scenes.say_uz: Gapning to‘rt turi bor: sodda, teng qo‘shma, tobe murakkab va aralash. Yaxshi matn hammasini aralashtiradi.

scenes.title: Gap boshini o‘zgartirish
board: Participle: Exhausted, he left.
Adverbial: Last year, we moved.
Subordinate: Although it rained, ...
Preposition: In the morning, ...

examples.t: Exhausted, he left early.
After the meeting, we went for lunch.

scenes.say: Do not start every sentence with the subject. Begin with a participle, a time phrase, a subordinate clause or a prepositional phrase.
scenes.say_native: Hamma gapni egadan boshlamang. “I went. I saw. I bought.” kabi yozuv zerikarli. Gap boshini o‘zgartiring: sifatdosh bilan — “Exhausted, he left early”, vaqt bildiruvchi ibora bilan — “Last year, we moved”, ergash gap bilan — “Although it rained, ...”, yoki old qo‘shimchali ibora bilan — “After the meeting, ...”.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma gapni egadan boshlamang. Sifatdosh, vaqt iborasi, ergash gap yoki predlogli ibora bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Oldin va keyin
board: Before: I woke up. I was tired. I made coffee. I read the news.
After: Tired after a poor night's sleep, I woke up and made coffee, then read the news.

examples.t: Tired after a poor night's sleep, I made coffee and read the news.
examples.uz: Uyqusiz tundan charchagan holda, qahva tayyorlab, yangiliklarni o‘qidim.

scenes.say: Here is a paragraph before and after. The first version has four short, identical sentences. The second version flows as one natural sentence.
scenes.say_native: Mana misol. Birinchi variantda to‘rtta qisqa, bir xil gap bor: “I woke up. I was tired. I made coffee. I read the news.” Ular robotning gapiga o‘xshaydi. Ikkinchi variantda hammasi bitta ravon gapga aylangan: sifatdosh ibora boshida turibdi, ikki fe’l “and” bilan, so‘ng “then” bilan bog‘langan.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi variantda to‘rtta bir xil qisqa gap bor. Ikkinchisida hammasi bitta ravon gapga birlashgan.

scenes.title: Uchta gapni birlashtiring
board: 1) The café was small. It was noisy. We loved it.
2) He missed the train. He called his boss.
3) She is shy. Her sister is confident.
scenes.say: Combine each group into one good sentence. One: The café was small. It was noisy. We loved it. Two: He missed the train. He called his boss. Three: She is shy. Her sister is confident.
scenes.say_native: Har bir guruhni bitta yaxshi gapga birlashtiring. Birinchisi: kafe kichik edi, shovqinli edi, biz uni yaxshi ko‘rdik — zidlik so‘zi ishlating. Ikkinchisi: u poyezdni o‘tkazib yubordi, boshlig‘iga qo‘ng‘iroq qildi — sifatdosh ishlating. Uchinchisi: u uyatchan, singlisi ishonchli — qiyoslash so‘zi ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir guruhni bitta gapga birlashtiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Although the café was small and noisy, we loved it.
2) Having missed the train, he called his boss.
3) She is shy, whereas her sister is confident.
scenes.say: One: Although the café was small and noisy, we loved it. Two: Having missed the train, he called his boss. Three: She is shy, whereas her sister is confident.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Although the café was small and noisy, we loved it”. Ikkinchi: “Having missed the train, he called his boss”. Uchinchi: “She is shy, whereas her sister is confident”. Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, bu yaxshi, chunki bir nechta to‘g‘ri yo‘l bor.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Although the café was small and noisy, we loved it. Ikki: Having missed the train, he called his boss. Uch: She is shy, whereas her sister is confident.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ish suhbati
board: Interviewer: Why should we hire you?
Dina: Having managed a small team for three years, I know how to lead.
Dina: Although I'm young, I've delivered results.
Dina: I'm calm under pressure, whereas many people panic.
scenes.say: Interviewer: Why should we hire you? Dina: Having managed a small team for three years, I know how to lead. Although I'm young, I've delivered results, and I stay calm under pressure, whereas many people panic. Interviewer: Impressive. Despite your age, you sound very experienced.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — ish suhbati. Intervyu oluvchi “nega aynan sizni ishga olishimiz kerak?” deb so‘raydi. Dina esa murakkab tuzilmalar bilan javob beradi: “Having managed” — sifatdosh gap, “Although” — zidlik, “whereas” — qiyoslash. Shu tuzilmalar tufayli uning nutqi ishonchli va kuchli eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Intervyu oluvchi: Nega sizni ishga olishimiz kerak? Dina: Uch yil kichik jamoani boshqarganim uchun qanday boshqarishni bilaman. Yosh bo‘lsam-da, natijaga erishganman, bosimda xotirjam qolaman, ko‘pchilik esa vahimaga tushadi. Intervyu oluvchi: Ta’sirli. Yoshingizga qaramay, juda tajribali eshitilasiz.

scenes.title: Dina nima dedi?
board: 1) How long did Dina manage a team?
2) Which word shows contrast with her age?
3) How does she compare herself with others?
scenes.say: Answer three questions. One: how long did Dina manage a team? Two: which word shows contrast with her age? Three: how does she compare herself with other people?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Dina jamoani qancha vaqt boshqargan? Ikkinchi: yoshiga zid fikrni qaysi so‘z bildiradi? Uchinchi: u o‘zini boshqalar bilan qanday qiyoslaydi? Qisqa, lekin to‘liq inglizcha gaplar bilan javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) For three years.
2) Although.
3) She stays calm, whereas many people panic.
scenes.say: One: for three years. Two: although. Three: she stays calm under pressure, whereas many people panic.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uch yil. Ikkinchi: “although” — “Although I’m young, I’ve delivered results”. Uchinchi: u bosim ostida xotirjam qoladi, ko‘pchilik esa vahimaga tushadi, bu “whereas” bilan qiyoslangan. Intervyuda va ish suhbatlarida shunday tuzilmalar nutqingizni yuqori darajaga ko‘taradi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: uch yil. Ikki: although. Uch: u xotirjam qoladi, ko‘pchilik esa vahimaga tushadi.

scenes.title: Ovoz va ritm: vergullarni eshitish
board: Pause at the comma: Although it was late, | we stayed.
Intonation rises, then falls
Main clause: falling tone

examples.t: Although it was late, we stayed.

scenes.say: When you say a complex sentence aloud, pause briefly at the comma. Your voice rises a little on the subordinate clause and falls at the end of the main clause.
scenes.say_native: Murakkab gapni ovoz chiqarib aytishda ham tuzilma muhim. Vergulda qisqa to‘xtang. Ergash gapda ovozingiz biroz ko‘tariladi, chunki fikr hali tugamagan. Bosh gapning oxirida esa ovoz pasayadi, chunki fikr tugadi. Masalan: “Although it was late” — ovoz ko‘tariladi, to‘xtash, “we stayed” — ovoz pasayadi.
scenes.say_uz: Murakkab gapni aytayotganda vergulda to‘xtang. Ergash gapda ovoz ko‘tariladi, bosh gap oxirida pasayadi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: yozing
board: Combine into 2 sentences:
The meeting was long. It was boring. I took notes. I learned a lot.
Use: although, a participle, or whereas.
scenes.say: Final writing task. Combine these four short sentences into two good ones: The meeting was long. It was boring. I took notes. I learned a lot. Use although and a participle.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy yozma topshiriq. To‘rtta qisqa gap berilgan: yig‘ilish uzoq edi, zerikarli edi, men yozuv oldim, ko‘p narsa o‘rgandim. Ularni ikkita yaxshi gapga birlashtiring. “Although” va sifatdosh gapdan foydalaning. Daftaringizga yozing, vergullarni to‘g‘ri qo‘ying va ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta qisqa gapni ikkita yaxshi gapga birlashtiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Although the meeting was long and boring,
taking notes, I learned a lot.
Or: Taking notes throughout, I learned a lot, although the meeting was long and boring.
scenes.say: A possible answer: Although the meeting was long and boring, I took notes. Taking notes helped, so I learned a lot. Other good versions exist too.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: “Although the meeting was long and boring, I learned a lot by taking notes.” Bu bitta gapda zidlik ham, ergash gap ham bor. Yana bir variant: “Taking notes throughout, I learned a lot, although the meeting was long and boring.” Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lsa, shu uch narsani tekshiring: vergul to‘g‘ri qo‘yilganmi, sifatdoshning egasi “I”
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: Although the meeting was long and boring, I learned a lot by taking notes.

scenes.title: Darsning xulosasi
board: Coordination: FANBOYS + comma
Subordination: one connector only
Participles: same subject!
Despite + noun, although + clause
Vary length and openings
scenes.say: Let's review. Join equal ideas with FANBOYS. Subordinate with one connector. Check your participle's subject. Despite plus noun, although plus clause. And always vary your sentences.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: teng bog‘lanishda FANBOYS so‘zlari va ularning oldida vergul. Ikkinchi: tobe bog‘lanishda bitta munosabatga bitta bog‘lovchi. Uchinchi: sifatdosh gapda ega bir xil bo‘lsin, aks holda “dangling” xato bo‘ladi. To‘rtinchi: although bilan gap, despite bilan ot yoki -ing.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: teng bog‘lanishda FANBOYS, tobe bog‘lanishda bitta bog‘lovchi, sifatdoshda bir xil ega, although bilan gap, despite bilan ot va xilma-xil gaplar.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: Combine 10 simple sentences into 4 complex ones
Check: 4 sentences, 4 different structures, no comma splices
scenes.say: Your homework: combine ten simple sentences into four complex ones. Use at least one participle clause and one concession structure. Check commas and subjects.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘nta oddiy gapni to‘rtta murakkab gapga birlashtiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘rtta gapning har biri boshqacha tuzilishda bo‘lsin, kamida bittasida sifatdosh gap, bittasida although yoki despite bo‘lsin, comma splice xatosi bo‘lmasin. Ovoz chiqarib o‘qib, ritmni tekshiring.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: o‘nta oddiy gapni to‘rtta murakkab gapga birlashtiring. Kamida bitta sifatdosh gap va bitta zidlik tuzilmasini ishlating.

homework_uz: O‘nta oddiy gapni to‘rtta murakkab gapga birlashtiring. Har birida boshqacha tuzilma bo‘lsin, kamida bittasida sifatdosh gap, bittasida although yoki despite bo‘lsin va comma splice xatosi bo‘lmasin.

options: I was tired, I went to bed.
I was tired, so I went to bed.
I was tired so, I went to bed.
I was tired, because so I went to bed.
quiz.why_uz: Vergul yolg‘iz ikki gapni bog‘lamaydi. So bog‘lovchisi kerak.

quiz.q: Although it was raining, ___ we went out.
quiz.why_uz: Although bilan but ishlatilmaydi. Bir munosabatga bitta bog‘lovchi.

quiz.q: ___ the rain, we went for a walk.
quiz.why_uz: Despite dan keyin ot keladi va of qo‘shilmaydi.

options: Despite it was late, we stayed.
Despite of the late, we stayed.
Despite the fact that it was late, we stayed.
quiz.why_uz: Despite dan keyin gap kerak bo‘lsa, the fact that qo‘shiladi.

quiz.q: Which sentence has a dangling participle?
quiz.why_uz: Yomg‘ir yurmaydi. Sifatdosh egasi bosh gap egasiga mos kelmayapti.
Hisobotni tugatgan odam bosh gapning egasi bo‘lishi kerak: she.

quiz.q: The man ___ next to me is my boss. (who is sitting)
quiz.why_uz: Faol ma’noda who is ni tashlab, -ing ishlatamiz.

quiz.q: Tom is outgoing, ___ his brother is shy.
Which word means the same as 'but' and shows a surprising contrast?

options: When I will arrive, I'll call.
quiz.why_uz: Vaqt ergash gapida kelasi zamon o‘rniga hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi.
